note: Times are wall-clock seconds in the 30s (sped) cut, aligned to phase boundaries: setup~0.7, launch~3.8, track~7.7, jam~22.4, recovery~26.3.

events.text: Forty-six silent pods watch a ten-kilometre zone.
Tracking. The fix locks to one metre as it weaves.
Jammed. We degrade to a bearing, never blind.
